entities.name: Beibit Zhukayev
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Beibit Zhukayev is a Kazakh tennis player. He has a career high ATP singles ranking of world No. 171 achieved on 20 May 2024 and a doubles ranking of No. 327 achieved on 3 October 2022. He is the current No. 5 Kazakh player.
